market_bullets: 10/10 same-day notes; 9 Today calls lean flat-to-up, while NVDA leans flat-to-down. These are low-conviction directions, not certain gains.
All 10 tracked RSI readings remain below 50; 7 of 10 VEL5 readings are negative. Repair is widespread, but durable trend confirmation is absent.

NVDA’s roughly 5% negative premarket contrasts with mostly recovering semiconductor peers. Its note attributes the divergence to governance-risk repricing, not a proven security breach or sector-wide demand collapse.
ASML and AMD are notable positive premarket snapshots: ASML disclosed executed buybacks; AMD/Google confirmed EPYC hosts for TPU 8tx. Neither establishes new scanner/GPU order dollars.
Positive VEL5 in INTC, NET and QCOM is only one completed repair bar. Sub-50 RSI, cash-conversion questions and prior fades keep same-day confidence modest.

Monthly framing is much more defensive than annual framing. Several notes report weak monthly direction accuracy despite broad band containment; confidence is subjective, not a measured hit probability.
Across AI hardware, prioritize accepted revenue, customer collections, capex and dilution. Financing commitments, deposits and unpriced debt offers must not be relabeled operating free cash flow.

All prices retain original note timestamps and the November 6 close anchor; they are asynchronous pre-open indications, often with zero reported volume. Forecast bands describe terminal closes, not intraday trading ranges.
